title: I made a free browser game of The Wind in the Willows — explore the river bank from your childhood dreams. 7 scenes, zh/en/ja, no install
author: Puzzleheaded_Call912
selftext:
I read The Wind in the Willows when I was a kid and kept wishing I could step inside it. I finally built it — a browser game, made with AI.

Chapter 1: The River Bank. 7 scenes, afternoon to dusk. Tap and drag, no install, zh / en / ja.

How it actually got made, since that's the interesting part

* I didn't write the code by hand. I described scenes in plain language on [makeplay.ai](http://makeplay.ai) and let it build.
* The first pass looked fine and was wrong in the ways only a player notices — the characters floated in mid-air instead of standing on the ground.
* Fixing it was the same motion: describe what looked off, get it changed.
* What I did decide: which 7 scenes, that it moves from afternoon to dusk, the picnic as the emotional beat from day one.

Play free: [https://makeplay.ai/p/4tfckdacva](https://makeplay.ai/p/4tfckdacva)  
If there's a chapter you'd want next, tell me.

*the English basket monologue is missing its commas — that's the wall of text at 0:48, I know, it's on the list*
